projects.title: A Butterfly With a Heart
projects.description:
Vala remains the largest mobile telephony in the country to this day, largely due to its timely rebranding and complete image reconstruction. 

A gigantic public company with a monopoly in telecommunications industry at the time, its image wasn't the most popular among consumers, who were eager to see the second, more affordable mobile telephony, enter the market. 

Faced with a threat of losing the majority of its clients to the competition in arrival back in 2007, we engaged in a bold transformation of Vala 900 from conservative and outdated, to a modern and consumer-oriented brand, reshapin…
